item.title: About
item.description: Hello, I’m Ying-Hsien Lee, a passionate developer graduating from Feng Chia University with a B.S. in Computer Science. My technical journey goes beyond writing clean code—from founding an independent brand and automating operational workflows, to serving as CTO at the EIA in Portugal, I am driven by the desire to “use technology to solve real-world business pain points.” I believe that an exceptional software engineer needs not only a solid understanding of system architecture but also cross-cultural communication skills and a sharp product sense.
